query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM team t
                WHERE t.id = $1
                  AND (
                      t.owner_id = $2
                      OR EXISTS (
                          SELECT 1 FROM team_user tu
                          WHERE tu.team_id = $1 AND tu.user_id = $2 AND tu.team_role = 'owner'
                      )
                  )
            ) AS "owns!"
